principle: One canonical evidence→slot factory for all brands; brand identity is input, not a forked pipeline

stages.label: Hotel Property Census footprint (read-only)
stages.note: Never auto-CERTIFY; LIVE_UNVERIFIED allowed for reconstruction drafts

stages.label: FDD / franchise disclosure diligence (no invented fees)
stages.note: Do not fabricate Item 5–7 percentages. Prefer labeled diligence guidance.

stages.label: Parent loyalty program (public)
sources: Hilton Honors / IHG One Rewards / Marriott Bonvoy public pages
yields: Public elite tier names when attributable

stages.label: Competitive soft-brand comparisons
stages.note: Class-level peers only unless brand-specific comparison evidence exists

stages.label: Brand-specific imagery & materials
sources: CALA census photos when licensed for display
stages.note: Never invent URLs. Prefer official brand CDN before paid stock/professional packs.

stages.label: Paid research / licensed docs (founder-gated)
stages.note: Activate only after free stages exhausted. Not required for every brand.

EXTRACTION_FAILED.label: Evidence exists but extraction failed
EXTRACTION_FAILED.remediation: Improve Brand Basics / official / PI extractors; re-run evidence pack

GENERATOR_MAPPING_FAILED.label: Evidence exists but generator mapping failed
GENERATOR_MAPPING_FAILED.remediation: Extend universal slot mapper (slot aliases, numbered collections)

PUBLIC_RESEARCH_NEEDED.label: Evidence insufficient — public research needed
PUBLIC_RESEARCH_NEEDED.remediation: Official pages, press, parent loyalty, development news (free HTTP first)

PRIVATE_PROPRIETARY_REQUIRED.label: Private or proprietary material genuinely required
PRIVATE_PROPRIETARY_REQUIRED.remediation: Founder-authorize FDD/manual/licensed imagery; or ship diligence guidance + NOT_DISCLOSED

OPTIONAL_INAPPLICABLE_UNDISCLOSED.label: Optional, inapplicable, or must remain undisclosed
OPTIONAL_INAPPLICABLE_UNDISCLOSED.remediation: Mark APPLICABLE_POPULATED_NEGATIVE / RENDER_NOT_DISCLOSED / exclude from applicable denominator only when inventory classifies non-applicable

exclusions: Do not read production Presentation bodies as generator input
Do not copy completed brand fixtures into the generator
Do not invent fee %, contractual terms, or gallery URLs
Do not create brand-specific generation pipelines
